messages:
Anya: Quick check-in: ran initial bring-up for 'horizon-lite-9b' in int6. Short cost vs quality summary below (slices: chat, search, longform).

Sam: Nice — what harness and sample sizes?

Anya: Standard onboard harness, 200 samples per slice. Key numbers: latency p95 int8=120ms, int6=210ms; throughput tokens/sec down ~18% on int6; infra cost per 1k tokens int8 ~$0.012, int6 ~$0.007 (~1.7x infra savings).

Lee: Those latency deltas could show up in product. What about quality?

Anya: Quality deltas small on average but concentrated: longform ROUGE-L -0.7, search MRR -0.9% absolute, chat human QA -0.05 on 5pt scale, hallucination proxy +0.5% focused on numeric/date extraction prompts. CI is noisy (200 samples), ROUGE CI ±0.3, MRR ±0.6%. Recommend a 1k-sample canary for search.

Marta: Blended unit econ for our traffic mix (70% chat,20% search,10% longform)?

Anya: Blended infra cost per 1k tokens: int8 ~$0.0102, int6 ~$0.0061. Blended quality score (normalized): int8=0.964, int6=0.955.

Sam: So ~35-45% cost savings with small quality loss. Any rollout recs?

Anya: Proposed ops plan: 1) Hybrid routing — keep int8 for sensitive routes (search, billing, numeric extraction), send bulk chat to int6. 2) Canary: 1k-sample shadow + 5% live chat, 20% search for 48h. Rollback triggers: MRR drop >0.5% or halluc proxy +1.0%. 3) Prompt mitigations: add numeric-check post-filter and tighten retrieval prompts for int6. 4) Cache TTL increase for longform prefixes to reduce spend.

Lee: Can you paste a routing prototype?

Anya: Pseudo-rule:
route_rule { match: metadata.slice in ["search","billing"] model: "horizon-lite-9b-int8" fallback: "horizon-lite-9b-int6" }
route_rule { match: metadata.slice == "chat" && estimated_tokens < 1024 model: "horizon-lite-9b-int6" }
canary { route: "search" traffic_pct: 20 guard: { metric: "MRR", threshold: -0.5 } }

Marta: GTN needs a short blurb for messaging.

Anya: Blurb suggestion: "Int6 gives ~35–45% infra savings with small average quality regressions. Recommend hybrid routing: preserve int8 for high-precision retrieval and numeric-sensitive features; use int6 for bulk chat. Start with a 48h canary and require MRR/hallucination gates before full rollout."

Sam: Next steps?

Anya: I'll run the 1k-sample extended report, produce a product one-pager, and enumerate prompt patterns that trigger failures (multi-step numeric reasoning, dense date-heavy contexts).

Sam: DeployBot, schedule the 5% chat canary after the 1k job completes.

DeployBot: Canary scheduled: horizon-lite-9b-int6 chat route, 5% traffic, start=2026-03-23T15:12Z. Monitoring hooks: MRR, latency_p95, hallucination_proxy.

Marta: Great, please drop the 1k results and sample failures here when ready. :thumbsup:
